subject: Board & Investor Q1 packet — timeline, priority slides, and preview
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Board & Investor packet — first draft + asks

Folks — attaching the first full draft of the Q1 Board & investor packet (PDF attached). I want to align on priorities so we send a clean preview to BrightCap on Thursday. High-level asks: 

- Please mark your top 3 slides that must be finalized before preview.
- Laura: editorial & narrative flow (exec summary + CEO note).
- Karthik: OKR/metrics slide validation (I flagged a couple numbers).
- Monica: ops/risks + legal checklist; do we need a redline to legal?
- Lauren: sign-off / investor comms timing.

Target timeline: feedback by EOD Wed (2026-02-11). I want a preview to BrightCap on Thu (2026-02-12) with a 1-slide summary + archive of the full packet. Final deck freeze by end of day Fri (2026-02-13).

Attachments: 2026_Q1_Board_Packet_draft.pdf

Thanks — planning to consolidate comments into a single annotated PPT and send an updated deck tomorrow morning.

Marcus Lin
Head of FinanceOps
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Board & Investor packet — first draft + asks

Thanks Marcus — read through and added inline notes. Quick summary of my asks: 

1) Move the "Market Signals" slide earlier (page 3) so the narrative hooks before the metrics.
2) Tighten the CEO note to two paragraphs and call out the major customer wins (one-sentence bullets).
3) Small copy edits on slide 7 (growth commentary) — attached redlines as PPT: redlines_board_deck_annotated.pptx.

Top-3 priority slides for me: Exec Summary, Market Signals, Net Revenue Retention headline.

On the legal side: I agree we should loop legal for a quick read; Monica, can you confirm availability?

Laura
VP, Communications

Attachments: redlines_board_deck_annotated.pptx

Samantha — attaching a one-slide summary and the full draft board packet for your preview. We value BrightCap's feedback and would like to share a short read-ahead before the formal board send. 

Key asks:
- If you have 15 minutes, could you confirm whether the level of detail on ARR and runway is sufficient?
- Any immediate redlines we should account for before Thursday?
- Are you available for a 30-minute sync on Fri Feb 13 at 10:00 AM PT?

Attachments: 2026_Q1_Board_Packet_draft.pdf, 2026_Q1_one_page_summary.pdf

Thanks — appreciate the quick look.

Marcus Lin
Head of FinanceOps
Redwood Inference

- Can you clarify the ARR reconciliation on slide 10? The definition seems different from last quarter. If possible, add an ARR bridge slide (FY-end -> Q1) following slide 10.
- One minor ask: call out how customer concentration changed this quarter (top 5 customers %).

I can do Fri Feb 13 at 10:00 AM PT for a 30-minute call. Contracts copied for any pre-reads on terms.
